HOLIDAY STORY 1

Noah

Back to Basics
📖 Read

Last summer, my dad and I went on a back-to-basics holiday. My little twin brothers are only six, and Dad thought they were too young for this kind of adventure. So it was just the two of us! We stayed at a small campsite in the middle of nature. There were no shops, no hotels and no swimming pools. It was very simple, but I really liked it.

There was no Wi-Fi and no electricity. We could not charge our phones or watch television. There was also no running water. If we wanted water, we got it from a clean lake near the campsite.

There was no shower either. We washed in the lake. The water was very clear, but it was also very cold. At first, I did not like it very much. After a few days, I got used to it.

We slept in a tent and cooked our food outside. In the evening, we used small lamps and torches. Sometimes we made a fire. We sat around the fire, talked and looked at the stars. It was very dark at night because there were no streetlights.

Clothes were not important there. At home, people sometimes care about clothes and brands. Some people want nice trainers or popular clothes. On holiday, nobody cared about that.

I usually wore old shorts, a T-shirt and flip-flops. My clothes often got dirty, but that was not a problem. Everybody wore simple and comfortable clothes. Nobody cared about brands or fashion. I really liked that.

During the day, we were outside a lot. We walked in the woods, went swimming and played games. My dad and I also looked for wood for the fire. Sometimes we went fishing.

There were some other families at the campsite. I met a few boys and girls my age. Because there was no Wi-Fi, we did not sit on our phones all day. We played cards, talked, swam in the lake and spent a lot of time outside.

One evening, we went swimming before dinner. The sun was going down and the sky was orange and pink. After swimming, we sat near the fire and ate marshmallows. It was a very simple evening, but it was great.

Before the holiday, I thought I would miss Wi-Fi, hot water and my phone. In the end, I did not miss them very much. I liked the quiet place, the lake and being outside every day.

When we got home, I was happy to have a warm shower again. But I also missed the campsite. I would definitely like to go on a back-to-basics holiday again.

HOLIDAY STORY 2

Abby

Surf Holiday
📖 Read

Last summer, I went on a surf holiday with my family. We stayed near a big beach with lots of waves. I had never surfed before, so I was a little nervous at first. But after the first lesson, I really liked it.

Every morning, we went to the beach after breakfast. Most days, I wore my swimsuit or a surf suit because we were in and out of the water all day. When I was not surfing, I usually wore shorts, a light T-shirt or a summer dress.

Clothes were very simple there. Nobody wore smart clothes because we spent almost the whole day on the beach. Between surf lessons, most people only wore swimwear, shorts or a towel around them. It was too hot for heavy clothes, and there was no reason to dress up.

At home, people sometimes care about clothes, trainers and brands. On the beach, that was different. Your clothes got wet, sandy and salty anyway. Nobody cared if your shorts were old or if your T-shirt did not match.

The surf lessons were great. First, we learned how to stand on the board on the beach. Then we went into the water. At first, I fell off the board many times. Sometimes I only stood for two seconds, but that still felt amazing.

After a few days, I got better. I could catch small waves and stay on the board for longer. The instructors were friendly and helped us a lot. I also met other teenagers during the lessons.

Between the lessons, we relaxed on the beach. We swam, played beach volleyball, ate ice cream and listened to music. Sometimes we walked along the beach and looked for shells.

The best time was in the late afternoon. The beach was quieter and the sun was not so hot. We sometimes went back into the water for one last surf before dinner.

In the evening, I was always very tired. My hair was full of salt, my feet were sandy and my clothes were usually wet or covered in sand. But I did not care. Everyone looked the same after a long day on the beach.

I really liked the relaxed feeling of the holiday. You did not need many clothes or expensive things. A surf suit, swimwear, shorts, a T-shirt and flip-flops were enough.

The holiday made me want to surf again. I was tired every day, but I was also very happy. I would definitely go on another surf holiday.

HOLIDAY STORY 3

Ameena

Survival Camp
📖 Read

Last summer, I went on a survival camp with a group of other teenagers. It was in a wild area with hills, trees and rocks. We slept in tents and spent almost the whole day outside.

Before the camp started, the leaders told us not to bring our best clothes. That was good advice, because every day we got very dirty. We wore old T-shirts, shorts, trainers or just swimwear when it was really hot. Sometimes our clothes were wet, muddy or covered in dust. Nobody cared about looking smart. Everyone looked dirty after a few hours anyway.

Every morning, we had breakfast together and then started the first activity. One day, we went hiking in the hills. The walk was long and sometimes very hard. We had to climb over rocks and walk on small paths. It was tiring, but the view from the top was amazing.

We also went climbing. At first, I was a little nervous because the rocks were high. We wore helmets and special climbing equipment. The leaders helped us and showed us what to do. When I reached the top, I felt really proud.

Another activity was abseiling. We went down a high rock with a rope. I was scared when I looked down, but I tried not to think too much about it. I listened to the leader and went slowly. After a few minutes, I was back on the ground. I wanted to do it again!

One day, we explored some caves. It was dark, cold and wet inside. We wore helmets with lights on them. In some places, we had to bend down or crawl under rocks. My trousers got very dirty that day, but it was one of my favourite activities.

We also had a treasure hunt. We worked in small groups and followed a map. We had to find clues in the forest and answer questions. Some clues were easy, but others were difficult. My group got lost once, but we found the right path again.

In the evenings, we were usually very tired. We sat together, talked about the day and sometimes played games. Nobody used their phone very much because there was always something to do.

I liked the camp because everything was different from normal life. At home, people sometimes care about clothes, brands and looking good. At survival camp, that did not matter at all. You wore old clothes because you knew they would get dirty. It was much more important to help your group, try new things and have fun.

At the end of the week, I was tired, dirty and happy. I had done things I had never done before. I would definitely go on a survival camp again.

HOLIDAY STORY 4

Luca

Holiday Park
📖 Read

This summer, my family and I are going to our favourite holiday park in France. We go there every year. The weather is usually smashing, with blue skies and sunshine every day. You can be outside all day, feeling the sun on your skin and enjoying the fresh air.

The park is great because you can really relax and just be yourself. At school, we wear uniforms, so everyone wears the same outfit. Outside school, it is very different. Sometimes it feels like you need the right brands or the right trainers to fit in. That can be very stressful. Over there, none of that matters. You do not have to worry about what to wear. Flip-flops are the dress code. It’s very relaxing not having to worry about what to wear.

The park is quite far away from towns and busy places, and there is no Wi-Fi. That sounds boring, but it isn’t. After a few days, you forget about your phone completely. There is always something to do, and you spend most of the day with your friends anyway.

Every morning, I have breakfast outside with my family and then meet my friends near the sports field or the swimming pool. You do not need much for the day: a towel and your flip-flops are usually enough. The ground can get really hot in the sun, and there are stones everywhere, so walking around barefoot is not always a good idea.

Last year, we played volleyball and badminton almost every day. We went swimming, hung out by the river, played games or watched the canoes go past. People on the river are sometimes surprised to see us playing in the river like this, but we don’t really care, we’re used to it. We just smile and wave.

I also joined activities at the holiday park, like table tennis, sports games and evening activities with other teenagers. That was always fun because you quickly got to know new people. Some of them come back every year, and we always have a great time together. We talk online during the rest of the year, so it is always great to see each other again in the summer.

These holidays are always really relaxed. After a few days, you start to wonder why people worry so much about clothes when, in the end, they are just clothes. Maybe that is one of the reasons I like it there so much. Last year was one of the best holidays ever, and I really hope this year will be even better. I am already looking forward to those long sunny days, spending time with my friends and feeling completely free.

HOLIDAY STORY 5

Raheem

Road Trip
📖 Read

This summer, my parents, my sister and I are going on a road trip through England. We are going to travel by car and stay in different places along the way. I really like road trips because every day is different. One day you can be in a busy city, and the next day you can be walking through the countryside.

The best thing about this kind of holiday is the freedom. You do not have to follow the same plan every day. Sometimes we stop somewhere because we see a nice village, an old castle or a beautiful beach. My dad loves looking at maps and finding new places to visit, while my mum usually checks where we can get something nice to eat. My sister and I mostly care about whether there is something fun to do.

Being in the car for a long time can sometimes be boring. My sister and I usually listen to music, play games or look out of the window. Sometimes we argue about what music to play, but that never lasts very long. We also have snacks in the car, which makes the long drives a lot better.

Last year, we visited small towns, went for long walks and had picnics in the countryside. One day, we stopped at a little village because my mum saw an old church from the road. We walked around for a while and found a small café where we had cake and hot chocolate. It was not planned at all, but it was one of the nicest stops of the whole trip.

We also stayed near the coast for a few days. I loved walking along the beach, eating fish and chips and watching the boats in the harbour. My sister collected shells, and my dad tried to take photos of everything. One evening, we sat on the beach until it started to get dark. It was cold, but none of us really wanted to leave.

In the evenings, we often played cards or talked about what we had seen that day. Sometimes we were all tired, so we just relaxed in our room and watched something together. My sister always wanted to know what we were doing the next day, but my parents usually said we would decide in the morning.

That is another thing I like about road trips. You never really know what is going to happen. Sometimes the best part of the day is something you did not plan at all.

Road trips can be a little tiring, especially after a long day in the car, but I really enjoy them. I like seeing lots of different places and spending time together as a family. I hope this year will be just as much fun, and maybe we will find a few new favourite places along the way.

HOLIDAY STORY 6

Mia

Canoe Trip
📖 Read

Last summer, my parents and I went on a canoe trip in France. We travelled down a river for several days and slept at small campsites along the way. It was very different from our normal holidays, but I loved it.

We took almost everything with us in the canoe. Our clothes, food and sleeping bags were all packed in waterproof bags. There was not much space, so we could not take many things.

Because we were on the water every day, our clothes were very simple. I usually wore shorts, a life jacket, a T-shirt, swimwear and old trainers or water shoes. We also wore life jackets whenever we were in the canoe. Sometimes my clothes got wet, so I changed into dry clothes at the campsite.

Nobody cared much about fashion on the trip. After a day of paddling, everyone looked a bit tired, wet and messy. Your clothes only had to be comfortable and easy to dry.

Every morning, we packed the tent and put everything back in the canoe. Then we put on our life jackets and started paddling again. Some parts of the river were calm, but other parts were faster. We had to work together and listen carefully to each other.

Sometimes we stopped on a small beach to eat lunch or swim. The water was cold, but after sitting in the canoe for a long time, it felt great.

One afternoon, we passed a busy holiday park near the river. The sun was shining, and we could hear people laughing and shouting from the riverbank. Children were running around, and others were splashing about in the water. Everyone seemed to be having a great time. I was a little surprised by the dress code. Flip-flops seemed to be everyone's favourite outfit! A boy noticed me looking at him. He didn't seem embarrassed at all. He just smiled and waved at me. I smiled and waved back. I didn't know some people spend their holiday like that. It looked like a very relaxed way to do so, but I don't think I would go there. My parents just smiled, and we continued down the river, leaving the happy sounds of the holiday park behind us.

At the campsites, we cooked outside and ate near our tent. In the evening, we were usually too tired to do much. We talked, played cards or sat by the river.

The best part was waking up next to the water. In the morning, the river was very quiet and there was often a little mist above it. It looked beautiful.

The trip was not always easy. My arms hurt after long days, and sometimes everything felt wet. But I liked travelling this way. Every day was different, and we never knew exactly what we would see.

I would definitely go on another canoe trip. You do not need much: a canoe, a life jacket, simple clothes, some food and a place to sleep. For me, that was enough.
